$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 — CE-9005 (docs/designs/vehicle-tactics/DESIGN_Road_Convoy.md §5 S-6): mode 1, the priority escort and its column cross a red; the user's rule 'the convoy ignores traffic lights'. No golden yet (first run). The never-splits rows read POSITIONS (far, CE-9009), so they judge the same in both tiers (the trail lives only on the kinematic owner). A split is a pair more than 60 m apart = one gap + the three gaps of lag at which the lead's cap stops it (C-6): past that the cap failed to hold the column. 📌 Measured in the cluster tier (real time, longer frames): a follower falls ~40 m behind its predecessor for a few seconds at the 12 m junction kink at x 300 (CE-9011) and recovers by x 400 — the cap at work, not a split.
